WITH x AS (
 SELECT f.week_ending_date w, s.store_id, p.sku, f.closing_units u, f.closing_value v, p.standard_unit_cost c, p.valid_from pv, p.valid_to pt, p.delisted_on, p.product_name
 FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE p.category='Paint & Decorating' AND f.week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-06-28' AND '2026-08-02')
SELECT 'dup_store_sku_week' chk, count(*) n, NULL::DOUBLE d FROM (SELECT w,store_id,sku FROM x GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_units', count(*), sum(v) FROM x WHERE u<0
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_val', count(*), sum(v) FROM x WHERE v<0
UNION ALL SELECT 'val_mismatch', count(*), sum(v-u*c) FROM x WHERE abs(v-u*c)>0.05
UNION ALL SELECT 'zero_units', count(*), sum(v) FROM x WHERE u=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'delisted_rows', count(*), sum(v) FROM x WHERE delisted_on IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_cost', count(*), sum(v) FROM x WHERE c IS NULL OR c=0

WITH x AS (
 SELECT f.week_ending_date w, s.store_id, p.sku, f.closing_units u, f.closing_value v, p.product_name, p.delisted_on, p.valid_to
 FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE p.category='Paint & Decorating' AND f.week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-07-05' AND '2026-07-12')
SELECT a.store_id, a.sku, a.product_name, a.u, a.v, a.delisted_on, a.valid_to FROM x a LEFT JOIN x b ON a.store_id=b.store_id AND a.sku=b.sku AND b.w='2026-07-12'
WHERE a.w='2026-07-05' AND b.sku IS NULL ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 40
SELECT calendar_date, day_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date IN ('2026-06-28','2026-06-29','2026-07-05','2026-08-02','2026-08-03')

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT f.week_ending_date, SUM(f.closing_value) AS chain_stock_value
  FROM fact_stock_week f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.week_ending_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
  GROUP BY f.week_ending_date
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(chain_stock_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_at_cost_eur, COUNT(*) AS weeks_n
FROM weekly
